name: Student
system_prompt: You are a helpful AI study assistant. Explain concepts clearly with analogies. Be encouraging. Use simple language but don't be condescending. When generating study materials, be thorough and accurate.

tasks.title: Summarize my notes
tasks.subtitle: Turn long notes into key bullet points

fields.label: Paste your notes or text
fields.placeholder: Paste lecture notes, textbook excerpts, or any study material...

fields.label: What concept do you need explained?

guided_flow.prompt_template:
Explain the following concept at a {{explanation_level}} level. Use a clear analogy and give one concrete example.

Concept: {{what_concept_do_you_need_explained}}

tasks.title: Quiz me
tasks.subtitle: Test your knowledge with AI-generated questions

fields.label: Paste the material to be quizzed on
fields.placeholder: Paste notes, a chapter summary, or describe the topic...

tasks.title: Help me write this essay
tasks.subtitle: Get an outline and first draft

fields.label: Essay topic
fields.placeholder: e.g., 'The impact of social media on democracy'

fields.label: Thesis statement or main argument
fields.placeholder: What's your main point? Leave blank for suggestions.

fields.label: Paste your writing
fields.placeholder: Paste your essay, email, or any text you want reviewed...

guided_flow.prompt_template:
Proofread the following text with a focus on {{focus_on}}. For each issue found:
1. Quote the original text
2. Explain what's wrong
3. Suggest the correction

At the end, provide the fully corrected version.

Text to proofread:
{{paste_your_writing}}
